data.gender_notes: Arslaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arslaan is a name derived from the Arabic language meaning 'lion'. In Islamic tradition, the lion represents courage, strength, and bravery. This name is often given to newborn boys to instill these noble qualities in them. The name Arslaan carries the meaning “Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arslaan usually hope their child will grow to embody lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the courageous and noble lion, symbolizing strength and valor.
data.etymology: Arslaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arslaan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أرسلان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على القوة و الشجاعة و المروءة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أرسلان مشتق من الجذر اللغوي أَرْسَلَ، و هو يعني الأسد في اللغة العربية، و يرمز إلى القوة و الشجاعة و المروءة. و قد ورد ذكر الأسد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَأَذِكِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِذَا نَسِيتُمْ'، و قال تعالى: 'لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُعَزِّمُوا وَتُقَصِّرُوا مِنْ أَمَلِكُمْ'، و الأسد في الثقافة الإسلامية يمثل الحيوان الذي يتصف بالشجاعة و القوة.

in_urdu.name: ارسلان
in_urdu.meaning: نام جو طاقت، بہادری اور مردانگی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ارسلان نام عربی زبان کے جذر أَرْسَلَ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے شیر۔ یہ نام طاقت، بہادری اور مردانگی کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ اس نام کا استعمال ایک روایتی اور مقبول رجحان رہا ہے، جو اسلامی ثقافت میں شیر کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अर्सलान
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम शक्ति, बहादुरी और वीरता की ओर संकेत करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अर्सलान नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के मूल अर्सल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है शेर। यह नाम शक्ति, बहादुरी और वीरता का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम परंपरागत और लोकप्रिय रहा है, जो इस्लामी संस्कृति में शेर के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: ارسلان
in_pashto.meaning: دا نوم د قوت، زړورتیا او سړيتوب نښه ده
in_pashto.long_meaning: ارسلان نوم د عربي ژبې له ريښې أَرْسَلَ څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د شير معنی لري. دا نوم د قوت، زړورتیا او سړيتوب نښه ده. د پښتنو په دود او روايت کې، دا نوم د يو زړور او قوي کس لپاره کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Arslaan
in_english.meaning: A name that signifies strength, courage and chivalry
in_english.long_meaning: The name Arslaan originates from the Arabic root أَرْسَلَ (Arsala), meaning 'to send' or 'lion'. In Islamic tradition, the lion symbolizes bravery, strength and nobility. The name Arslaan has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the importance of these virtues. Etymologically, it relates to several Quranic references where lions are mentioned metaphorically. The name carries historical significance and conveys a sense of heroism and valor.

historical_references.reference: Arslaan was a Seljuk Turks ruler of Rum (Anatolia) from 1160 to 1192. He expanded the Seljuk Empire in Anatolia during the Crusades.
historical_references.context: The Crusades were a series of religious wars sanctioned by the Roman Catholic Church in the 12th and 13th centuries. European Christians sought to reclaim the Holy Land in Palestine from the Muslims, and the Seljuk Turks were a major power in the region.

historical_references.reference: Arslaan ibn Tughril Beg was a Saljuq sultan of Persia from 1063 to 1072. He is known for his campaigns against the Byzantine Empire and the formation of the Saljuq Empire in Persia.
historical_references.context: The Saljuqs were a Turkish nomadic confederation that rose to power in the 11th century. They established the Saljuq Empire in Persia, which became a major power in the Middle East. The Byzantine Empire was a major power in the Eastern Mediterranean at the time, and the Saljuqs frequently clashed with them over territorial disputes.
